description: Sends one prompt to Perplexity (sonar) and reports whether it cites your target domains, with citation count and cited domains. Free: 5 calls per caller and 200 calls total per UTC day; both limits fail closed.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the search assistant(s), verbatim. 1 to 4000 characters.

targets.description: 1 to 10 target domains to check for a citation.

items.description: A normalized domain, e.g. example.com (no scheme, no path, no whitespace, lowercase).

name: citation_tracker_check_perplexity
title: Check Perplexity citations
